relations.product: Blue Moon human landing system for the Artemis V mission (NASA's second Artemis lunar lander provider)
relations.quote: To develop a human landing system for the agency’s Artemis V mission to the Moon, NASA has selected Blue Origin of Kent, Washington.
relations.label: NASA press release: NASA Selects Blue Origin as Second Artemis Lunar Lander (05-19-2023)

relations.product: New Glenn launch of NASA's ESCAPADE Mars mission (NASA listed among partners committed to New Glenn)
relations.quote: NASA ESCAPADE is a dual spacecraft mission to study solar wind energy on Mars.
relations.label: Blue Origin product page: New Glenn (10-17-2026)

relations.product: requirements definition for how Blue Origin systems and technologies could be used for the rocket cargo mission (Air Force Research Laboratory; Space Force research, development, test and evaluation funds)
relations.quote: Blue Origin LLC, Merritt Island, Florida, has been awarded an $11,707,762 firm-fixed-price modification (P00001) to a previously awarded contract (FA2385-25-C-B023) to define requirements for how Blue Origin systems and technologies could be used for the rocket cargo mission
